title: Plan AJ: AI Industry Newsletter
summary: Subscribe sources → aggregate news → AI digest → layout → scheduled send
scenario: For operators running a daily or weekly newsletter in a vertical industry — automating research and first drafts.

steps.title: Subscribe sources
steps.detail: Use RSS or scraping nodes to funnel target sources (official blogs, industry media, competitor news) into one inbox. Tag by topic and dedupe repeated coverage.
steps.tips: Perfect ~10 high-quality sources first — info noise is a newsletter's worst enemy.

steps.title: Aggregate news
steps.detail: For major events, use Perplexity to research context and collect multiple angles. Keep only what readers genuinely need to know; drop the rest.
steps.tips: Ask three questions daily: what happened today, who does it affect, what to watch next.

steps.title: AI digest
steps.detail: Feed the filtered raw items to the model and have it output a fixed structure: one-line summary + key facts + editorial note. A fixed template keeps every issue's format consistent.
steps.tips: Feed the previous issue as a few-shot example and the output style aligns automatically.

steps.title: Layout
steps.detail: Apply a newsletter template in Notion, fill in summaries and links, and check headings and hierarchy. Add a table of contents, bold key points and source links.
steps.tips: Store date/topic/status in Notion database fields for easy re-sends and history.

steps.title: Scheduled send
steps.detail: Set a fixed daily/weekly time to auto-draft and send; run 2-3 issues manually first to confirm stability. After launch, track open and click rates to tune topics and headlines.
steps.tips: Pick the time when your subscribers are most active, then scale frequency once data supports it.

pitfalls.title: Too many, too noisy sources
pitfalls.detail: An over-fed aggregator produces a grab bag; keep under 10 curated sources.

pitfalls.title: Distorted AI summaries
pitfalls.detail: Digesting drops detail or cherry-picks context; manually verify key items against the original.

pitfalls.title: Fully hands-off automation
pitfalls.detail: A broken auto-flow goes unnoticed; spot-check weekly at the start.

pitfalls.title: Clickbait burning trust
pitfalls.detail: Blown-up headlines on thin content spike unsubscribes; let headlines match the content.
